title: Stutter Choir
description: A choir-like sawtooth vowel pad that is chopped to ribbons by rhythmic tremolo gating, the gate re-rating from slow swells to a machine-gun flutter and back over a 24-cycle loop. Euclidean ply bursts and cycling vowels keep the throat shifting while a resonant bandpass crawls and the whole thing breathes inside a long room.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  note("<c4 [c4 d4] f4 eb4 [g4 eb4] c5>/2")
    .s("sawtooth")
    .vowel("<a e i o a u e i>/3")
    .ply("<1 2 1 4 2 1 3 2>/2")
    .struct("<t(3,8) t(5,8) t(7,8) t(3,8,2)>")
    .tremolosync("<4 8 16 8 32 16 8 4>/2")
    .tremolodepth(tri.slow(13).range(0.55, 0.95))
    .tremoloskew(saw.slow(11).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .bpf(tri.slow(16).range(380, 2600).add(saw.slow(23).range(0, 700)))
    .resonance(sine.slow(29).range(8, 17))
    .shape(sine.slow(7).range(0.15, 0.5))
    .crush(perlin.slow(17).range(16, 6))
    .pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .off(0.012, x => x.add(note(0.11)).gain(0.5))
    .sometimesBy(0.14, x => x.speed(-1))
    .room(saw.slow(19).range(0.3, 0.6)).roomsize(0.75)
    .gain(0.82)
)
